en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4814 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Jamil ibn Salih, from Al-Fudayl ibn Yasar, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a man who said to his wife, "I have given you the choice," and she chose herself before standing up.
Imam (as) said: "That is valid against him."
I asked: "Is she entitled to maintenance (compensation)?"
Imam (as) said: "Yes."
I asked: "Does she inherit if the husband dies before her waiting period ends?"
Imam (as) said: "Yes, and if she dies, the husband inherits from her."
